title: Oyster’s Pearl | Designer WaterColor Home | Exclusive 30A
meta_description: Discover Oyster’s Pearl, a designer WaterColor beach house loaded with amenities like a private pool, golf cart, and bikes
description_expanded: Oyster's Pearl Features - Complimentary Use of a 6-seater LSV (golf cart). Some restrictions apply and must sign a waiver to use the cart during your stay - Access to 4 Taxi bikes, serviced regularly to keep them in top shape - Private pool. Can be heated for an additional fee for reservations October - April - 1 minute bike ride to Dragonfly Pool (heated seasonally) - 5-minute bike ride or LSV (golf cart) drive to Camp WaterColor. Access to water slides, a lazy river, and the cantina included with your reservation - Short bike ride or LSV (golf cart) drive to the famous WaterColor Beach Club, with multiple pools, towel service, tiki bar, and snack bar - Back porch overlooks pond and features two seating areas - 1,400 square feet of porch space including screened-in side porch with outdoor dining and lounge area - Surrounded by nature preserve with view of the Pine Lily Circle Pond from the back patio - Private porches off king suites - Enclosed outdoor shower - Outdoor natural gas grill - 8 at dining room table and 4 at breakfast bar. Everyone can eat together! - Gourmet kitchen featuring Wolf Gas Range and Oven, wine chiller, and extra ice maker - Laundry room with HE Washer and Dryer on 1st floor - Smart TVs throughout home. Sonos sound bar for living room TV - Living room gas fireplace - 2nd floor deluxe suite with gas fireplace and private office area with desk and comfy chair - Driveway parking for 3 cars - Access to the WaterColor Beach Club, Camp WaterColor and all community pools included with your reservation for 11 guests age 5 and up - Community pools heated during cooler months (subject to change by the neighborhood) - Detached Carriage house and garage not available for guests. - At least one mid-stay clean is required for any reservation 10 days or longer and this cost is included in your reservation. Extra cleans can be scheduled for an additional fee This stunning Southern Living style home is a showcase example of style and comfort. Beautiful views of surrounding nature preserves and pond, this peaceful retreat is sure to impress all who stay here. With three king suites and one kids suite that sleeps up to 5, there is plenty of room for everyone to relax. The professional decor, luxurious bedding, elegant fixtures, and oyster shell fireplace will have you relaxing in elegance. On the first floor is an open floor plan, chef inspired kitchen with wine chiller, elegant dining area, and comfortable living room with gorgeous views- perfect for enjoying time with your family. Plus there is a gorgeous oyster shell inlaid fireplace in the living room to keep everyone cozy when the sun goes down. With over 1,400 square feet of porch space, including 2 screened-in porches, this is truly a showcase home you won't want to miss out on!
